records.title: On 69645ee0: that stack with zero-multiplicity rows of the fixed LogUp tables neither combined nor inverted

parents.note: The measured hand-off stack this builds on.

records.summary: In write_frac_cols, rows whose numerator is zero (they add exactly zero) skip the batch inverse; verify_bitwise_xor_12 and range_check_20 return a zero numerator at once for rows whose multiplicities are both zero, skipping their combines.

payload.hypothesis: On top of rgr1_48643c05 (stack9 with the witness writers' table hand-offs side by side, 0.9769 against 69645ee0), the Cairo interaction phase (0.12 s at 9-10 of 16 cores) is mostly two fixed-table LogUp writers: verify_bitwise_xor_12 (346 ms of 870 ms single-thread locally) and range_check_20 (158 ms). Each row's fraction is -(m1 d0 + m0 d1) / (d0 d1) with d the combined lookup of a fixed table row; rows whose multiplicities are both zero add exactly zero to the running sum, yet their two combines, their product and their share of the batch inverse are computed.
payload.mechanism: constraint-framework/src/prover/logup.rs write_frac_cols: per chunk and column, only rows with a nonzero packed numerator are batch-inverted and added to the running sums (the others add zero, so every written value is the same field element). verify_bitwise_xor_12 and range_check_20 return a zero numerator at once when both multiplicity lanes are zero, skipping their combines. The other write_frac_cols users (memory tables, range_check_9_9) skip only the inversion of zero rows. Byte-identical proofs (3 statements, cmp against the frontier, privacy_verify ACCEPTED); no verifier, channel, FRI, constraint, Merkle hashing or parameter change.
payload.expected_effect: Estimate only: Cairo interaction single-thread 1359 to 1208 ms locally (-11%); on the evaluator a few ms to 15 ms of a 0.12 s phase that runs below full occupancy, 0.1-0.4%.
payload.test_plan: Byte identity on 3 statements and privacy_verify; offline preflight (1,572,554 bytes); evaluator job against 69645ee0 with phase evidence (cairo_interaction).

records.title: Experiment: On 69645ee0: that stack with zero-multiplicity rows of the fixed LogUp tables neither combined nor inverted
records.summary: The whole proof was measured faster than the frontier in no more memory.

payload.finding: The evaluator measured 0.9748 of frontier 69645ee0's time (95% CI 0.9675-0.9821) and a peak of 2.79 GiB against its 2.78 GiB in the same job; the slow end of its interval was at least 1% faster than that frontier and its peak stayed within the frontier's.

records.title: On 69645ee0: that stack with zero-multiplicity rows skipped in four more fixed tables (Cairo and circuit) and Cairo interaction markers

parents.note: The measured 0.9748 stack this builds on.

records.summary: range_check_9_9 and the circuit's verify_bitwise_xor_12, range_check_16 and verify_bitwise_xor_9 return a zero LogUp numerator at once for zero-multiplicity rows; markers split cairo_interaction at four writers' ends; 12 KB of plain comments removed for patch size.

payload.hypothesis: rgr1_1056aa9e675c7755edc101bd8cd3a1b6d74eddba9e63aca612d34eb0cbfedf00 (stack9, side-by-side writer hand-offs, zero-multiplicity LogUp rows skipped) read 0.9734 and 0.9748 against 69645ee0 (job 0cd2b110); cairo_leg 0.15 to 0.13 s, but cairo_interaction stayed at 0.12 s while its busy cores rose from 10.0 to 11.7, so the phase is set by a chain, not by work. range_check_9_9 has the same fixed-table shape as range_check_20 (zero multiplicities add zero), and which interaction writer ends the phase is not visible in the phase profile.
payload.mechanism: range_check_9_9 (Cairo) and the circuit tables verify_bitwise_xor_12, range_check_16 and verify_bitwise_xor_9 return a zero LogUp numerator at once when their multiplicity lanes are zero (as Cairo range_check_20 and verify_bitwise_xor_12 already do), skipping their combines; the circuit tables already skip the inversion of zero rows through the shared write_frac_cols. Diagnostic: stderr markers pvfast-phase ix_xor12, ix_rc20, ix_blake_g, ix_blake_round when those four Cairo interaction writers finish, so the evaluator profile splits cairo_interaction at their finish times. About 12 KB of this stack's own plain // comment lines are removed (comments only) to keep the patch well under the cap: a 1,572,554-byte version of the parent hit LEASE_EXPIRED at admission three times while 1,568,700 bytes passed. Byte-identical proofs (3 statements, cmp against the frontier, privacy_verify ACCEPTED); no verifier, channel, FRI, constraint, Merkle hashing or parameter change.
payload.expected_effect: Estimate only: a few ms from range_check_9_9 and from the circuit interaction (0.09 s at 12 cores); mainly a diagnostic of the interaction phase's critical writer for the next change.
payload.test_plan: Byte identity on 3 statements and privacy_verify; offline preflight (1,562,087 bytes); evaluator job against 69645ee0 with the ix_* markers in the phase evidence.

records.title: Lazy-reduced AVX2 dot products in composition: one canonical reduce per few terms
records.summary: Composition spends much time in deferred-constraint dot products (flush_deferred, combine_by_coordinates). Accumulate unreduced 64-bit products, fold mod P every 3 terms and reduce once; result is the same canonical field element, so proofs are byte-identical. Portable std::simd path kept.

payload.hypothesis: Composition spends much time in deferred-constraint dot products (flush_deferred, combine_by_coordinates). Accumulate unreduced 64-bit products, fold mod P every 3 terms and reduce once; result is the same canonical field element, so proofs are byte-identical. Portable std::simd path kept.
payload.mechanism: VeryPackedM31::add_dot_broadcast with AVX2 lazy reduction in crates/stwo/src/prover/backend/simd, used by SimdDomainEvaluator::flush_deferred and combine_by_coordinates.
payload.expected_effect: at least 1% faster whole proof, byte-identical proof, peak memory within the frontier's
payload.test_plan: evaluator job on this lead; local build plus byte-identity check
